note: The schema-layer case: the test lifts config-version-table in memory, removes `unknownPolicy` from one type of the assembled document, and hands the fault-injected value to `emit`, which must raise exactly one blocking INVALID_IR naming that type's instance pointer and write only the diagnostics sidecar (FR-097-AC-2). No committed bundle can express a missing member the frontend always emits, so the fault is injected after assembly and before the reader.
